verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־ קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ bā·ră·ḵî nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḵāl qə·rā·ḇay ’eṯ- šêm qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: Of David Bless the LORD O my soul all that is within me bless His holy name

verses.original: בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל־ תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל־ גְּמוּלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵî nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·’al- tiš·kə·ḥî kāl- gə·mū·lāw
verses.literal: Bless the LORD O my soul and do not forget all His kind deeds

verses.original: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־ עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־ תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃
verses.transliteration: has·sō·lê·aḥ lə·ḵāl ‘ă·wō·nê·ḵî hā·rō·p̄ê lə·ḵāl ta·ḥă·lu·’ā·yə·ḵî
verses.literal: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases

verses.original: הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·’êl miš·ša·ḥaṯ ḥay·yā·yə·ḵî ham·‘aṭ·ṭə·rê·ḵî ḥe·seḏ wə·ra·ḥă·mîm
verses.literal: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion

verses.original: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃
verses.transliteration: ham·maś·bi·ya‘ baṭ·ṭō·wḇ ‘eḏ·yêḵ tiṯ·ḥad·dêš kan·ne·šer nə·‘ū·rā·yə·ḵî
verses.literal: who satisfies you with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל־ עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ Yah·weh ū·miš·pā·ṭîm lə·ḵāl ‘ă·šū·qîm
verses.literal: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed

verses.original: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏî·a‘ də·rā·ḵāw lə·mō·šeh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: He made known His ways to Moses His deeds to the people of Israel

verses.original: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב־ חָֽסֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ra·ḥūm wə·ḥan·nūn Yah·weh ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥā·seḏ
verses.literal: The LORD is compassionate and gracious slow to anger abounding in loving devotion

verses.original: לֹֽא־ לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- lā·ne·ṣaḥ yā·rîḇ wə·lō lə·‘ō·w·lām yiṭ·ṭō·wr
verses.literal: He will not always accuse us nor harbor His anger forever

verses.original: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ḵa·ḥă·ṭā·’ê·nū ‘ā·śāh lā·nū wə·lō ḵa·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū gā·mal ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities

verses.original: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל־ יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵiḡ·ḇō·ah šā·ma·yim ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ gā·ḇar ḥas·dōw ‘al- yə·rê·’āw
verses.literal: For as high as the heavens are above the earth so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him

verses.original: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־ פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kir·ḥōq miz·rāḥ mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ hir·ḥîq mim·men·nū ’eṯ- pə·šā·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: As far as the east is from the west so far has He removed our transgressions from us

verses.original: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל־ בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־ יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ra·ḥêm ’āḇ ‘al- bā·nîm ri·ḥam Yah·weh ‘al- yə·rê·’āw
verses.literal: As a father has compassion on his children so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him

verses.original: כִּי־ ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־ עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hū yā·ḏa‘ yiṣ·rê·nū zā·ḵūr kî- ‘ā·p̄ār ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: For He knows our frame He is mindful that we are dust

verses.original: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·nō·wōš ke·ḥā·ṣîr yā·māw kə·ṣîṣ haś·śā·ḏeh kên yā·ṣîṣ
verses.literal: As for man his days are like grass he blooms like a flower of the field . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־ בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא־ יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî rū·aḥ ‘ā·ḇə·rāh- bōw wə·’ê·nen·nū wə·lō- yak·kî·ren·nū ‘ō·wḏ mə·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: when the wind passes over it vanishes and its place remembers it no more

verses.original: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה׀ מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ ע֭וֹלָם עַל־ יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥe·seḏ Yah·weh mê·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām ‘al- yə·rê·’āw wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw liḇ·nê ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him and His righteousness to their children’s children

verses.original: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šō·mə·rê ḇə·rî·ṯōw ū·lə·zō·ḵə·rê p̄iq·qu·ḏāw la·‘ă·śō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh baš·šā·ma·yim hê·ḵîn kis·’ōw ū·mal·ḵū·ṯōw bak·kōl mā·šā·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD has established His throne in heaven and His kingdom rules over all

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh mal·’ā·ḵāw gib·bō·rê ḵō·aḥ ‘ō·śê ḏə·ḇā·rōw liš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·wl də·ḇā·rōw
verses.literal: Bless the LORD all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word who hearken to the voice of His command

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’āw mə·šā·rə·ṯāw ‘ō·śê rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Bless the LORD all His hosts you servants who do His will

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה׀ כָּֽל־ מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־ מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh kāl- ma·‘ă·śāw bə·ḵāl mə·qō·mō·wṯ mem·šal·tōw bā·ră·ḵî nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Bless the LORD all His works in all places of His dominion Bless the LORD O my soul
